topic: How to Make the Most of Your Omega Chi Epsilon Chapter
title: How to Make the Most of Your Omega Chi Epsilon Chapter
session_title: How to Make the Most of Your Omega Chi Epsilon Chapter
abstract: Officers and members of Omega Chi Epsilon, the National Chemical Engineering Honor Society, are encouraged to attend this session to meet with national officers and share best practices and favorite activities. Students from schools that do not have an Omega Chi Epsilon chapter are also invited to attend to learn more about establishing a chapter on their campus.
